resources.string: Hear yourself the way they will, before the call.
Wired, full quality. This is what Meet and Teams will use.
Wired, full quality. This is what Meet and Teams will use.
In a call, Bluetooth switches to a narrower call mode. The test plays exactly that.
Nothing plugged in: a call uses the phone microphone on the loudspeaker.
This is how they hear you
The microphone picked up nothing. Check that the mic isn\'t muted or covered, then try again.
They will struggle to hear you. Bring the mic closer to your mouth or speak up.
Good level. This is close to what the other side hears.
Your voice saturates. Move the mic a little away from your mouth.
Echo needs the microphone to record five seconds. The take stays in memory and is gone when you leave. Echo has no internet access.
The microphone is busy. Close the other app using it and try again.
No internet permission. No account. No tracking.\nYour voice never leaves your phone.
No account. No tracking. No ads.
Nothing leaves your device unless you choose it.

No app on this phone can open this link.
Echo stores nothing. Each take lives in memory and is gone when you leave the app, so there is nothing to erase.
Nothing. This app has no internet access.
Each take is recorded into memory, compressed and played back on the phone. It is never written to storage and never sent anywhere.
Echo keeps no data, and is excluded from cloud backups and phone-to-phone transfers.
Links in About open in your browser or mail app, only when you tap them. Echo itself never connects to anything.
